acceptance: The control-plane schema models user profiles, projects, and memberships with explicit ownership/member constraints.
Every exposed control-plane table has RLS enabled and explicit authenticated grants/policies; TO authenticated alone is never the authorization predicate.
The repository adapter requires a verified authenticated user identity and a dedicated control-plane Supabase configuration.
Service-role or generated-product credentials cannot enter browser-facing configuration or the control-plane repository contract.
Project list/create/read paths are tenant-isolated by user ownership or membership.
No remote Supabase side effect is required for exact-head CI; deterministic contract tests pass on Ubuntu and Windows.

required: Focused store/config/RLS contract tests including cross-tenant and generated-data-plane separation negatives.
Exact dependency pin and frozen-lockfile verification.
Exact-head Ubuntu and Windows repository CI.

minimality.rationale: Extend the existing control-plane package and use one pinned Supabase JS client instead of creating a separate backend package or remote project.

requirements: Control-plane and generated-product Supabase trust domains must remain distinct.
Never expose service-role/secret keys in browser configuration or NEXT_PUBLIC variables.
Authorization must be owner/membership based; authenticated role alone is insufficient.

outcome: Ineractive control-plane users, projects, and memberships persist through a bounded Supabase repository layer while generated-application data planes remain separate trust domains.
rationale: Next canonical P01 roadmap unit after SG-000013 accessible UI completion.

risk.recovery: Revert SG-000014 schema/repository/config/test artifacts and dependency pin; no remote project or database side effect is authorized.

scope_in: Define the minimum control-plane persistence model for authenticated users, projects, and project memberships.
Add a server-only Supabase repository adapter with explicit control-plane configuration and no service-role exposure to browser code.
Define control-plane schema/RLS artifacts with explicit Data API grants and owner/member isolation.
Add deterministic tests that prove generated-product Supabase project/config/secret identity is not accepted by the control-plane store boundary.
Record current Supabase changelog/documentation assumptions used by the implementation.
scope_out: No remote Supabase project provisioning, linking, billing, production mutation, or secret creation.
No generated-application backend compiler, migrations, RLS, storage, or product data.
No full login/session UI; authentication UX remains separate from this persistence slice.
title: IN-P01-S05-T01 Establish minimum Supabase-backed control-plane user/project store
